vulnerability_title: [M-08] Incorrect proportional reward splits when an operator has been slashed

recommendation.recommendation_text: Update `_getRewardReceiversAndAmounts` so that when the distribution type is `Proportional`, the function queries the actual bond amounts for each operator. Operators with reduced or zero bonds (due to slashing) should receive proportionally less or no rewards. This ensures accurate and fair distribution.

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: For the Proportional type, _getRewardReceiversAndAmounts gives every operator the same share: the reward divided by the number of instances plus one. It never reads the operators' current bonds, so an operator slashed to zero still gets a full share.
patterns_found: equal reward split that assumes equal bonds and ignores slashing
issues: ServiceRegistry::slash is in another file; the split logic is in this file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: proportional rewards ignore slashed operator bonds
